shipReasons: No critical defect found in the changed area: every FFX-2 chapter (IV, V, VI, XI, XV) was won by real keys at 1600x900 under the default Wait split, and XIII lost and then reached its retry, as the brief allows.
No regression against release 19 (43dca986). The FFX chapters I and IX give the same seeded outcomes, turns and screens as release 19. The FFX-2 flows reach every destination they reached before.

Each change meets its acceptance check. Menu-cancel: a plain hit leaves an open list open and Supercollider closes it. Acta Est Fabula heals only the two Redoubts. Lightfall hits each girl once. All 23 poses load their locked painting at the sidecar scale. Yojimbo shows no Sensor plate, and an ordinary target still shows one.

The one major on record, FOC19-01 (IC-1, the sole-survivor chain lock), was not introduced by this build and is not a regression. By Bailey's option B its switch stays OFF, so it is disclosed and carried.
